source: pvlib 0.15.0 pvwatts_dc, synthetic irradiance and cell temperatures
subset_description: Nine matched DC power/temperature cases. Supplied cell temperatures, irradiance 0–1200 W m-2, pdc0=1, gamma_pdc=-0.005, temp_ref=25.
citation: pvlib.pvsystem.pvwatts_dc at commit 247b31f71fc609e20e72ae6c1da186f9b5b45df4; Jerez et al. (2015), Methods equations 1–3, doi:10.1038/ncomms10014.

notes: reference.json records unmodified pvlib outputs, including 1.47 above rated capacity. The test clips separately under project policy. This independently checks only the power/temperature term, not the Chenni/Jerez thermal model. Thermal coefficients have separate hand-calculated specification tests. atol=1e-12 allows float64 roundoff only; C3S uses a different model and is not an exact oracle. Regeneration instructions are in README.md.
